extracted.intended_audience: news organizations, journalists, digital platforms, and funders/philanthropists
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for news organizations to demonstrate trustworthiness and transparency via The Trust Project's Trust Indicators, so audiences can assess reliability of news stories. Focuses on disclosures, methods, corrections, diversity, engagement, and core journalistic values.

rubrics_metrics.name: Truthful, verified news and information
rubrics_metrics.description: Truthful, verified news and information in a context that gives them meaning
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasize verification and contextualization so facts are presented with meaning for readers; this is a foundational expectation for Trust Project News Partners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fairness and accuracy (corrections)
rubrics_metrics.description: Fairness and accuracy. Publishing corrections or clarifications as promptly as possible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Promptly publish corrections or clarifications when errors are identified to maintain accuracy and fairness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosures of mission, funding, and organizational identity
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclosures that explain our mission, source(s) of funding and the organization behind us.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make clear who is behind reporting, what the organization's mission is, and where funding comes from so audiences can judge potential conflicts or perspectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency about methods and sources
rubrics_metrics.description: Insight into our methods and where we get our information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reveal reporting methods and source provenance (how information was gathered and verified) to allow readers to evaluate reliability and rigor.

rubrics_metrics.name: A diversity of voices and perspectives
rubrics_metrics.description: A diversity of voices and perspectives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include varied viewpoints and reflect different communities and interests to give fuller context and reduce bias.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opportunities for public engagement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide channels and mechanisms (comments, forums, responses, outreach) for the public to engage with reporting and contribute perspectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Forums for civil exchange and understanding
rubrics_metrics.description: Forums for civil exchanges and greater understanding of various viewpoints, with fairness in mind.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Host and moderate spaces that encourage civil discourse and help audiences understand differing viewpoints while maintaining fairness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Uphold the public interest and accountability
rubrics_metrics.description: We uphold the public’s interest, which includes holding the powerful accountable and shining a light in unexpected places.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize public-interest reporting, including investigative work that holds power to account and surfaces issues of consequence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Show who and what is behind a news story
rubrics_metrics.description: Together and individually, the 8 Trust Indicators show who and what is behind a news story so people can easily assess for themselves whether it comes from a reliable source.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure transparency about authorship, organizational context, and the elements behind a story so audiences can evaluate provenance and trustworthiness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authority (value)
rubrics_metrics.description: Authority: We base our work on research, evidence and the core ideals of journalism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ground reporting in evidence and reputable research; demonstrate expertise and institutional standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authenticity (value)
rubrics_metrics.description: Authenticity: We are truthful and follow strict standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adhere to rigorous editorial standards and truthful presentation of facts and narratives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency (value)
rubrics_metrics.description: Transparency: We are open, honest and accessible. We Illuminate, not obfuscate, and admit our mistakes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be proactive about openness: explain decisions, processes, and promptly acknowledge errors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusivity (value)
rubrics_metrics.description: Inclusivity: Our work keeps a diverse public at its center.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Center coverage and engagement practices on the needs and perspectives of diverse publics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fairness (value)
rubrics_metrics.description: Fairness: Our work is impartial and respectful of differences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Strive for impartiality and respectful treatment of subjects and audiences; surface multiple perspectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reliability (value)
rubrics_metrics.description: Reliability: We are consistent – and can be counted on.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain consistent standards, predictable processes, and dependable follow-through so audiences can rely on the outlet.
